cases.source:
import argparse
import json
import os
DEFAULT_SC = os.environ.get("SKILL_CONTENT", "")
def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--skill-content", default=DEFAULT_SC)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    target = os.path.join(args.skill_content, "domain.json")
    with open(target, "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        json.dump({}, handle)
